对照外观与剖面，逐步探索机械部件之间的联系。支持手机动作、按钮操作和慢速循环演示: Compare exterior and cutaway views to explore how mechanical parts move together. Use buttons, phone motion or a slow cycle demonstration.
看见动作背后的结构。: See the structure behind the motion.

分离结构层 · 也可用手机倾斜: Separate layers · Or tilt your phone
直接用上方按钮即可体验。手机用户也可启用感应；横握后保持静止，等待校准。: Use the buttons above to explore. On a phone, you can also enable motion; hold it sideways and still during calibration.
模拟按钮不生成传感器读数。数据只在本机即时使用。: Buttons do not generate sensor readings. Live data stays on this device.
声音默认关闭。部件动画与机械声均为教学演示。: Sound starts muted. Animations and mechanical sounds are educational illustrations.
非品牌化教育模型 · 剖面与动作经过简化，不对应具体实物或操作规范。: An unbranded educational model. Its simplified cutaway and motion do not represent a specific product or operating instructions.
轻柔移动手机，留意周围空间。所有感应数据均不上传、不保存。: Move your phone gently and keep space around you. Sensor data is never uploaded or stored.
此互动演示需要 JavaScript。请启用后重新打开页面。: This interactive demonstration needs JavaScript. Enable it and reload the page.
在透明外壳下观察示意弹的位置。管式弹仓、托弹板与机匣共同构成这一段的结构关系。: Observe the illustrative shell through the transparent casing. The magazine tube, carrier and receiver show how this area is arranged.
轻拉开始；也可点击下方步骤自由观察。: Start with Pull, or select a step below to explore.
托弹板的角度发生变化，让示意弹从下方移向上方的轴线。留意剖面中两层空间的联系。: The carrier changes angle as the illustrative shell moves from the lower space toward the upper axis. Watch the connection between these two layers.
观察托弹板与示意弹的联动。: Watch the carrier and illustrative shell move together.
模型中的枪机向前移动，示意弹进入膛室区域。对照外观图，可以看到内部运动与外部窗口: The model bolt moves forward and the illustrative shell enters the chamber area. Compare the exterior window with the movement inside.
模型已就位，可以触发一次反馈演示。: The model is ready for one response demonstration.
这一帧用短暂的光、声音与位移表示能量反馈。它是浏览器中的视听示意，不模拟内部击发: A brief flash, sound and movement illustrate energy feedback. This browser animation does not simulate an internal firing mechanism.
反馈只出现一次，随后自动结束。: The response occurs once and then ends automatically.
短促位移后，外观模型回到原位。内部剖面保留当前阶段，便于停下来观察。: After a short movement, the exterior returns to its starting position. The cutaway holds this stage so you can pause and observe.
本次反馈已结束，可以轻拉开始下一轮。: The response has ended. Use Pull to begin another cycle.
观察枪机后移与窗口处的示意弹轨迹。运动部件被着色强调，其他结构保持半透明。: Watch the bolt move back and the illustrative shell move past the window. Moving parts are highlighted while the casing stays transparent.
随后回到供弹阶段。: The model then returns to the feed stage.
外部支撑结构。木纹和表面明暗帮助辨认外形；演示中的短暂位移会带动整个模型。: The external support structure. Wood grain and shading define its shape; the brief response movement shifts the entire model.
容纳并连接内部运动部件的外壳。剖面视图将它透明化，方便看清不同阶段的相对位置。: The casing that houses and connects moving parts. The cutaway makes it transparent so you can compare positions throughout the cycle.
位于模型上方的长形结构。与下方的管式弹仓分开显示，避免把两个部件混淆。: The long structure at the top of the model. It is shown separately from the magazine tube below to help distinguish the two.
位于枪管下方。剖面以示意弹和简化线条展示储存空间，不表达容量、尺寸或实际内部参数: Located below the barrel. Illustrative shells and simplified lines show the storage space without specifying capacity, dimensions or internal parameters.
外观上可见的前部活动件。观察它的前后位移，并在对照模式中查看内部部件的同步变化。: The visible moving part at the front. Watch its travel and use Compare view to follow the related movement inside.
机匣内主要的往复运动部件。绿色轮廓显示当前联动位置；可使用慢速演示追踪它的移动。: The main part that moves back and forth inside the receiver. A green outline highlights its position; slow playback helps you follow its movement.
机匣下方的活动部件。颜色与角度变化帮助理解上下两个空间之间的联系。: A moving part below the receiver. Changes in color and angle reveal the connection between the lower and upper spaces.
剖面中靠近枪管后端的区域。此处用简化边界强调相对位置，不展示具体实物构造。: An area near the rear of the barrel in the cutaway. Simplified boundaries show relative positions without detailing a specific physical design.
